common: PDF plan create parses a registry_record target and snapshot scope; assertLocalUsp requires the local operator.
protectPdfPlanTx calls targetTx: scopedManifestTx checks scope/access view/policy (NOT_FOUND or STALE_REVISION).
The manifest must select precisely one matching target (PACKET_PLAN_SELECTION); captured target/member hashes must agree (STALE_REVISION).
The target must be the same id, site and revision and a building/floor/space (PACKET_PLAN_TARGET).
assessPdfPlanTx checks current committed target, target history, full captured identity/aliases and original authority.
Retired/cancelled targets are PACKET_PLAN_TARGET_ACCESS; changed current/captured context is STALE_REVISION.
sourceStatement: A space with body.sourceOnly has exactly one entry under pack1-single-region-image/1; statementRecord validates SourceStatedRecordSchema.
Its selection bindingId is sourceStatementHandle(input.target), not a persisted citation id.
The recorded source revision/hash must be captured in the same manifest; missing member is STALE_REVISION, mismatched statement is PACKET_SOURCE_STATEMENT.
prepareSourceStatementBindings checks current canonical original, page metadata and bounded crop; region beyond the page is PACKET_SOURCE_STATEMENT.

IMPORTANT: changing one character of the handle does NOT throw from create today. It skips preparation, creates a blocked plan with committed_region_binding_unavailable, and confirm refuses PACKET_PLAN_BLOCKED. No existing behavior will be changed to turn that into a create refusal.
storedBindings: Other targets load RegistryDocumentCitationsSchema from captured target.body.documentCitations (up to 25).
Region ids are the stored citation.id, derived at reviewed canonical commit by regionCitationId or imageRegionCitationId.
targetTx finds the id and citation version selected by recipe: PDF page region, original image region, or mixed entry kind.
Matching binding must name target, an earlier target revision and record_evidence purpose; mismatch or broken integrity is STALE_REVISION.
Missing/non-region/wrong-version id yields blocked_required_context with committed_region_binding_unavailable, not a create refusal.

Source access checks current operator, access digest, retained bytes, original case and validation; PACKET_PDF_SOURCE_ACCESS, REGISTRY_REGION_SOURCE_DENIED, REGISTRY_REGION_COPY_UNSUPPORTED and STALE_REVISION can refuse.
Image/mixed recipes support building/floor only (PACKET_IMAGE_PDF_TARGET); aggregate/original-set recipe limits add PACKET_PDF_ORIGINAL_BYTES and PACKET_PDF_ORIGINAL_SCOPE.

order: assertLocalUsp; parse generate command; fingerprint it; executed() calls readPacketPlan, requires confirmed/executed/complete view (CARD_EXECUTED_PLAN_REQUIRED).
prepare transaction: protectedTx protects plan disclosure, authorizePlanTx checks access, planLinkageTx reads exact stored plan/confirmation/execution and PDF packet linkage.
requestReceiptTx takes transaction advisory lock and reads receipt. Replay validates card, actor/link/protected plan/lifecycle and stored card linkage, returning before expiry/projection.
No replay: expiry must be future and <=24 hours (CARD_EXPIRY).

Update: storedTx exact old card; actor; same plan/version and expected manifest (CARD_REVISION_CONTEXT); link; latest revision (STALE_REVISION); transaction card lock; lifecycle revocation (CARD_REVISION_REVOKED); integer revision bound (CARD_REVISION_BOUND).
projectCardFactsTx reads scoped manifest and exact captured bodies including source-stated ancestors/citation, verifies hashes and projects facts without writes.
authorizePlanTx again; database liveTx on requested expiry (CARD_EXPIRED). Prepare commits.
linkedPacket reads protected private packet bytes, validates receipt and linkage; then id/resolver/profile selection, PDF rendering, object put (first persistent write).
Publication repeats prepare, compares projection/revision, reauthorizes and inserts card/receipt/outbox atomically.
previewRepeats: Same executed-view read and protectedTx; same expiry/revision/projection/authorization/database-clock checks via extracted shared helpers; same linkedPacket read after transaction.
No receipt lookup: a preview has no request key and predicts a new command, never a replay. It takes no receipt lock.

Executed view, planLinkageTx and linkedPacket require an existing executed packet; expiry/revision guards and projection itself do not inherently require execution, but this route deliberately requires it.

writes: All preparation and linked-packet authority helpers issue SELECTs and transaction-scoped locks only; no receipt, lock row or access log is inserted.
requestReceiptTx only locks and SELECTs; preview skips it entirely. Row/advisory locks in shared protection expire at commit/rollback.
FOR SHARE helpers prohibit PostgreSQL READ ONLY transactions; use ordinary transactions with no DML, as K7 does, and assert no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in the protocol trace.
facts: generate answer data.facts is UspPropertyCardSchema.facts: ordered array of UspPropertyCardFactSchema (PropertyCardFact).
Both ASCII and Unicode renderers iterate precisely these facts, labels and values; unavailable/not_assessed values get a state prefix.

They also print a title/private-revision/snapshot header, application-summary disclaimer, footer card/plan/packet ids, entry counts, capture time, expiry, packet hash, fixed-snapshot and separate-access notices, QR/resolver link and private-access captions.
Preview answers facts, not an entire PDF transcript; it invents no id and cannot answer future card-id/QR/footer lines or guarantee font/layout rendering.
